notes: Frame: model metres, +X east, +Y grid north. Parking lots of the Village district north of y 1050, read from the NJ 2020 ortho (0.15 m/px, leaf-off) on gridded sheets at zoom 10 to 40; stall rows fitted to brightness profiles of the painted lines (a ridge filter, line minus the brighter of its two sides 0.3 m away, picks thin lines and rejects car edges; pitch by least squares, skew by maximising the line response, line ends from profiles along each divider); hidden dividers inferred from the pitch. Names from OSM parking areas.
